Sanitary Sewer Overflow in the 1200 block of Example reported Thursday Oct. 23, 2025

A concerned citizen contacted the City on Oct. 23, 2025 regarding a sanitary sewer overflow at the lift station on Example Avenue that serves the Bureau of Prisons' facility at Leavenworth. BOP-Leavenworth is working to contain the area. Interested parties should contact the BOP, (913) 555-0199 . Signs have been placed stating this is a contaminated creek area.
